comment: Index order is not panel order: the enum runs the three frequency knobs first and the three feedback knobs after, while the panel alternates them down the column (src/O.cpp:123-128), so the tags are written from the widget. The first frequency knob is configured -4 to 4 octaves and the other two -2 to 2 relative to it (src/O.cpp:42-46), and the CV input is added to all three. The shared feedback is a single value per polyphonic channel, updated once per sample from all three oscillators (src/O.cpp:99-101). The panel prints FRQ and FBK three times over, then CV and OUT.
